metadata.title: Progressive ONAM SADYA 2024 I SADYA REDEFINED with Tamil MASTERCHEF WINNER @ Indica, Delhi
metadata.description:
At Indica, New Delhi, tradition and innovation come together to create an extraordinary culinary experience, redefining the culinary space with inventive and bold interpretations of classic Indian dishes. The masterminds behind this unique menu are two celebrated chefs—one a Tamil MasterChef winner and the other a renowned chef from Bangalore. Together, they crafted a Contemporary Sadya that reimagines the traditional Onam feast, offering a fresh and exciting twist on familiar flavors.

Our journey began with Sambharam, a spiced buttermilk sorbet topped with green chili jam and curry leaf dust, a surprising yet delightful fusion of cool, tangy, and spicy elements. The next dish, Olan, was a delicate consommé with grilled pumpkin and steamed cowpeas, subtly flavored yet deeply comforting. Pachadi followed, featuring ash gourd carpaccio, delicately sliced and topped with flavored curd and mustard-chili oil, a perfect blend of textures and flavors.

The menu continued to surprise with Kondattam, where bitter gourd was transformed into crispy achappam, topped with beetroot kichadi and spiced pineapple jelly, bringing a playful mix of sweet, sour, and bitter. Thoran featured grilled plantain, beautifully glazed with inji puli and topped with coconut cream and toasted coconut, adding a delightful balance of sweetness and richness. 

Kootu Curry & Parippu Choru presented a yam terrine served alongside kootu curry sauce, fried shallots, channa jor, and parippu choru, with the added touch of kalyana maangai for that perfect tang. The meal progressed with Sambhar and Avial, a comforting spiced congee paired with steamed vegetables in avial sauce, served with chutta maangai chamandi and sago crisps for an extra crunch.

The experience concluded with two standout desserts: Pradhaman, an entremet with toasted coconut cake and salted jaggery caramel, and Subam, ari payasam panna cotta topped with caramelized banana and crispy poppadom. These desserts beautifully balanced sweetness with texture, rounding off a truly unforgettable meal.

Indica’s approach to this Sadya blends the essence of tradition with contemporary culinary artistry, creating a dining experience that not only honors but also redefines the flavors of the past.
